messages:
Maria: Heads-up — tonight's nightly eval spiked tool-calling schema failures for the quantized-v2 build (1.3q). Eval harness throws validation errors when parsing function outputs. Sample error: ```ERROR SchemaValidationError: field 'args' expected object but got string at eval_harness/validate.py:87```

Arjun: Can you paste a raw failing model output + the prompt/seed so we can reproduce?

Maria: Pasting one of the failed responses (copied from toolcalls.log):
```PROMPT: Retrieve profile for user 1234 (context: last_login)
MODEL_RESPONSE: {"tool_call": {"name": "get_user_profile", "args": "{'user_id': '1234'}", "metadata": "id:1234"}}
EVAL ERROR: SchemaValidationError - args should be JSON object, metadata should be object, got strings.```

Claire: This looks like the model returned Python-style single-quoted dicts inside a string for `args`. Did this start after we merged the quantization changes? :eyes: 

Maria: Yes — baseline (non-quant) run from last night had <1 failures. After the quantized-v2 rollout the counts jumped. Nightly summary (eval-bot) attached below.

eval-bot: nightly-report: processed=12400, toolcall_schema_errors=78, toolcall_schema_error_rate=0.63%, delta_vs_yesterday=+0.36%

Ben: Two quick hypotheses: 1) quantization changed tokenization/detokenization alignment for sequences that wrap JSON, so the model prefers plain-text/quoted output; 2) decoding distribution shift causes LLM to emit unescaped quotes or single quotes. We should collect token-level outputs to confirm.

Arjun: Repro steps? I'll try to run locally. Maria, can you share the exact command + artifact path + seed?

Maria: Repro steps I used locally: ```python -m eval.harness --model ./artifacts/quantized-v2:1.3q --prompts failing_prompts.json --seed 420 --log-toolcalls toolcalls.log```
The failing_prompts.json excerpt is in the shared drive (s3://redwood-evals/failing_prompts/2026-03-18.json).

Claire: Can you also run the same prompt file against the unquantized artifact to confirm it's not the prompt set?

Maria: Did that earlier — unquantized `baseline-v2` returns properly structured JSON function calls for the same prompts. So it's correlated with the quantized artifact.

Ben: For triage: 1) Maria add a few canonical failing examples to regression tests (checked into infra/evals/regressions). 2) Arjun/Ben to bisect quantization commits between tag v1.2q and v1.3q to find diff that increases stringified-args outputs. 3) Claire to make eval-harness more resilient: attempt `json.loads` on string `args` fields, and, if successful, accept it but flag as post-hoc fix. 4) Collect tokenization trace for N failed examples: include token IDs and detokenized tokens so we can see where quotes change.

Arjun: On bisecting — I'll start by building a couple of intermediate quant builds and run the failing_prompts subset. If it's repeatable locally I'll open a narrow revert PR.

Maria: I already added failing examples to infra/evals/regressions/quantized-toolcall-fails.json and linked the seed/logs at s3://redwood-evals/logs/1768123456-toolcall-debug.log.

Ben: Small mitigation for prod/hosted customers: implement a tolerant postprocessor that tries to coerce `args` when it's a string by doing `json.loads` then `ast.literal_eval` as fallback, then validate types. But we should NOT ship this as a permanent fix — it can hide regressions.

Claire: Agreed. Also if error rate goes above 1% we'll file an incident and consider rolling back that quant build on Dedicated lanes.

Maria: FYI I ran a token trace for one failure and saw tokens around the JSON boundary: ```tokens: [1234, 56, 78, 280, 34, 123, 39, 117, 115, 101, 114, 95, 105, 100, 39, 58, 32, 39, 49, 50, 51, 52, 39, 125, 125]``` — note the `39` (single quote) tokens in the decoded stream.

Arjun: That points to tokenizer/special-token handling. I'll inspect the quantization pipeline that changed byte-pair merges / embedding offsets.

Maria: Action items recorded: Maria (add regressions, logs) ✅, Arjun/Ben (bisect + build debug), Claire (harness tolerant parser + monitoring threshold), Eval-bot will post updated counts after next run.

Ben: If anyone wants to run quick local check: `python -m eval.harness --model ./artifacts/quantized-v2:1.3q --prompts failing_prompts.json --seed 420 --dump-tokens token_debug.json`

Claire: Thanks — keep updates in this thread. If we get >1% next nightly we escalate. :zap:

Maria: I'll post a short follow-up after the bisect starts. Thanks all.
